newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Spot markets quiet, basis weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Spot markets quiet, basis weak.

text.p: Spot soymeal markets were quiet with offers slipping at some locations in reaction to higher CBOT soymeal futures and to some processors resuming operations after taking maintenance downtime, dealers said.

Dealers reported increased buyer interest for June and July soymeal. Higher CBOT soymeal futures last week prompted livestock feeders to partially cover their June and July needs before additional price increases.
Soybean processors appeared more willing to price June and July positions than a few weeks ago, although they remain concerned about expected tight summertime soybean supplies.

Dealers said high-protein soymeal, basis Decatur, Ill., was offered for June at $18.00 per ton over the CBOT July futures contract and meal for July was offered $20.00 over, versus the spot offer of $10.00 over the CBOT May.
